milestones.name: Defeat Egis, Worn Out Sentinel
milestones.note: First boss of the game, located in a room full of broken robots

milestones.name: Unlock Hairpin
milestones.note: Granted after defeating Egis and interacting with Strange Tube / Samsk; player is teleported to a digital world

milestones.name: Meet Mel, Dr. Halyn's Property
milestones.note: NPC found on the other side of the door on the main path; becomes a merchant at The Severed Spine after conversation

milestones.name: Pick up Coating Component
milestones.note: Unknown object found on the ground after dropping down from the slope on the top-left

milestones.name: Absorb Tendrils
milestones.note: Found by interacting with a deactivated robot impaled in ice at the top-right section; permanently increases damage dealt

zones.name: Nacre Basin
zones.fingerprintHint: Accessible via crystal wall shortcut broken by striking it; encountered near the large staircase

zones.name: The Severed Spine
zones.fingerprintHint: Hub/main zone; Mel the merchant relocates here; shortcut opened via ice wall break

zones.name: Strange Tube
zones.fingerprintHint: Interactable object below the boss room; triggers conversation with Samsk and grants Hairpin ability

zones.name: Digital World
zones.fingerprintHint: Temporary area player is teleported to after unlocking Hairpin; contains a short parkour segment

abilities.name: Hairpin
abilities.grants: Grapple onto grapple points to reach upper sections
abilities.note: Unlocked after interacting with Strange Tube and speaking to Samsk following Egis boss fight

abilities.name: Absorb Tendrils
abilities.note: Obtained by interacting with a deactivated robot impaled in ice at the top-right section of the area

bosses.name: Egis, Worn Out Sentinel
bosses.note: First boss of the game; two phases but no new moves in phase 2 — only chains attacks faster; gets stunned after attack chains. Moves: Dash attack, Three hit combo, Diagonal Slam, Ground Slam.
